title: Accuracy assessment — disagreement map against committed truth

assertions.derivation: Lab grid contract: the disagreement map must inherit the 32x32 Byte class-map grid at 0.001 deg (same as tests/fixtures/lab/landcover_truth.tif).
D = |C - T| over class codes 1..4, so 0 <= D <= 3 with equality only for 1-vs-4 confusions; this scene's errors are all |2-3| = 1.

Truth-NoData block (rows 16-17 x cols 0-15 = 32 px) must stay excluded: 992/1024 = 0.96875 valid. Floor 0.96 admits NoData-propagating and zero-filled chains alike; the exact-value oracle is agree.* below.

Closed form: the classified stand-in maps truth class 3 (rows 24-27, 4x32 px) to class 2, so exactly the 128 class-3 pixels carry D = |2-3| = 1. A correct disagreement map must flag ALL of them (hit rate 1.0).
Every non-class-3 valid pixel agrees (D = 0) and the NoData block carries 0, so no pixel outside truth class 3 may show D = 1 — a correct map has false-alarm rate exactly 0.
